title: Gate Session History Entry
description: JSON Schema for individual JSONL entries in gate-state.history/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Each line is a serialized GateSessionHistoryEntry containing the full verbose audit trail for a completed compliance gate session.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier matching the compliance gate session ID format (e.g., cg_ses_1779323731637)

task_description.description: Original task description provided by the user at compliance_gate_check time

plan_summary.description: Execution plan summary confirmed via compliance_gate_confirm

execution_summary.description: Final execution summary provided at compliance_gate_complete time

audit.description: Audit metadata recorded at gate completion

status.description: Final gate session status. 'completed' = normal completion, 'drained' = force-drained as stale

session_id.description: Redundant session ID for cross-reference integrity

task_description.description: Redundant task description for cross-reference integrity (may differ slightly from top-level)

plan_summary.description: Redundant plan summary for cross-reference integrity

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when compliance_gate_confirm was called

consumed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when compliance_gate_complete consumed the armed state

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was marked as completed

execution_summary.description: Redundant execution summary for cross-reference integrity

audit_history_count.description: Number of audit history entries recorded for this session
